concerns.text: FR‑021 requires the primary model to achieve R² > 0.6 on the held‑out test set, but no task in the document enforces or verifies this threshold.
SC‑005 mandates measuring total pipeline execution time (≤ 6 h), yet no task records or validates overall runtime.
SC‑008 repeats the R² > 0.6 success criterion; there is no dedicated task that checks this metric against the required value.
The plan lists `contracts/model_output.schema.yaml` as a contract, but no task creates, validates, or otherwise exercises this schema.
